shared_elements: horizontal row of repeated identical small elements
band of linear/zigzag pattern running horizontally
small isolated figures scattered on an otherwise plain field
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry a horizontal row of many identical repeated small elements set on a line (crew strokes above a hull in A; a row of arch-and-bar signs beneath a patterned band in B), plus small schematic animal-like figures placed loosely on a plain ground. Otherwise the content is quite different: A's dominant subject is a large single boat with upcurved stems and no recognisable creatures, while B is filled with distinct profile birds, quadrupeds and a snake-like form arranged in stacked registers with no vessel or comparable object.
